name: Patient Support Program
one_liner: A ready-made foundation for pharma patient support and assistance programs: patients, enrolment, consent, documents, dispensing and free-of-cost schemes are already built; a program is described, not rebuilt.
fits_when: patients are enrolled onto a therapy and supported through it
a pharma company or its partner runs the program
medicine is dispensed, sometimes free or discounted under a scheme (buy-N-get-M, free-of-cost)
consent, prescriptions and clinical documents have to be collected and verified
field staff, distributors, pharmacies or doctors work the same patient record
adverse events have to be captured and reported
gives_you: Patients and caretakers, with a full patient 360 page
Enrolment onto one or more programs, with its own lifecycle and approvals
Consent — data processing, communication and program consent, with a register
Documents and prescriptions with per-program upload rules and verification
Orders and dispensing, paid and free-of-cost, with credit wallets and schemes
Tasks, timeline, adverse events and reporting

catalogue.description: Enrolment, eligibility, consent, document verification, free-of-cost dispensing and adherence for specialty therapies. The patient record, program lifecycles, wallet and schemes are already built; each program is configured from a journey spec rather than developed from scratch.

compliance: Data-processing consent captured before a patient is created
Consent withdrawal cascades to status, communication and archival
Adverse events captured regardless of communication consent
Role-scoped access, with every export logged
Client reports exclude patients who withdrew data consent
catalogue.app_prompt_prefill: A patient assistance program for a specialty therapy: register patients with consent, enrol them after checking eligibility and documents, and dispense free vials under a buy-N-get-M scheme through distributors.
